params.body:
Closes #88

## What changes

Curate, Reports:

- A report opens on a page of its own instead of unfolding inside the list. At the top its code, title and state, and "All reports" to go back; below it, in this order: what gentells.com shows, the file, the source list, the sources in the file.
- The open report is in the address (`&report=<slug>`). A reload stays on it, a link lands on it, and the browser's back returns to the year.
- A report added with "Add to the year" opens on its page, as it opened in the list before.
- The upload button takes the accent colour like the other buttons in the view.

Nothing changes in what is saved or sent; `ReportEditor` and the source panels are the same components.

## Checked

- `src/report-place.test.js`: the address helper. Suite 85 of 85, build clean.
- Driven in a headless browser: open a report, reload, browser back, "All reports". No page errors.
params.title: Reports: a report opens on a page of its own
